DISCLAIMER

Important limits on product information and advice.

Flurzi products are designed to support clearer workflows and digital experiences. They do not replace professional advice, independent verification or user responsibility. Last updated: 23 May 2026.

No legal or immigration advice

SponsorSafe HR may help organise sponsor licence records, right to work evidence, reminders and audit preparation workflows. It does not provide legal, immigration or Home Office advice. Employers should consult qualified advisers where needed.

No financial advice

Flurzi Commit may support commitment planning, progress tracking and behavioural structure. It does not provide regulated financial, investment, tax, debt, savings or credit advice.

Entertainment and reading content

FlurziCinema and End Novel may surface entertainment, stories, rankings, recommendations or viewing and reading experiences. Content availability, categorisation and presentation may change over time.

Information accuracy

We aim to keep product information useful and accurate, but laws, guidance, fees, product features, third-party requirements and content availability may change. Users should verify high-stakes information before acting.

User responsibility

Users remain responsible for their own compliance decisions, financial decisions, account activity, records, uploads, viewing choices, reading choices and actions taken inside or outside Flurzi products.
